objective: AH1 READ ONLY. Auditar EDARSAHUB SQL real para producir evidencia de REUSE/EXTEND/CREATE/DO_NOT_TOUCH antes de cualquier schema nuevo del BOS Agent Harness. Cubrir agent/skill/policy/evidence, comunicaciones/notificaciones, marketing/campanas/consentimiento/atribucion, cliente/CRM/RRR/Customer360 y mobile/device/offline/sync/push. No DDL, no DML, no cambios de codigo, no Production write.

queries.name: agent_skill_policy_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, o.name AS ObjectName, o.type_desc AS ObjectType FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Agent%' OR o.name LIKE '%Skill%' OR o.name LIKE '%Policy%' OR o.name LIKE '%Capability%' OR o.name LIKE '%Procedure%' OR o.name LIKE '%Execution%' OR o.name LIKE '%Evidence%') ORDER BY s.name,o.name

queries.name: agent_skill_policy_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS SchemaName,t.name AS TableName,c.column_id,c.name AS ColumnName,ty.name AS DataType,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Agent%' OR t.name LIKE '%Skill%' OR t.name LIKE '%Policy%' OR t.name LIKE '%Capability%' OR t.name LIKE '%Procedure%' OR t.name LIKE '%Execution%' OR t.name LIKE '%Evidence%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id
